output.summary: A shrub native to Southern and Eastern Africa, the Azores, the Arabian Peninsula, South Asia and East Asia. Its young leaves are deep red before becoming glossy dark green, while female plants produce small purple berries. Parts are used in milk- and meat-based soups by Batemi and Masai people, and the flowers are eaten.
